body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> PowerFilm (www.powerfilmsolar.com) showcased its portable solar chargers at CES 2010 in Las Vegas, which is used for recharging consumer electronics such as laptops, cell phones, GPS, and mp3 players.
They displayed their fordable solar charger, USB + AA charger, AA chargers and rollable chargers.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
